Planet:144: POPULATION / CITIZEN LIST — std::vector begin, one 16-byte element per population unit, count mirrored in Planet:352. Element layout CONFIRMED: +0 = JOB id, +4 = flags (0x004F0000 on most), +8 = owner-node, +12 = turnAdded (low 16 bits). Job ids: 0=farmer, 1=worker, 2=scientist, 5=miner, 6=banker (3 and 4 unobserved). Verified against a UI breakdown of 4 farmers/3 workers/2 miners and 8 farmers/2 scientists/1 banker — +0 was the only field in the element matching both distributions, and farmer=0 is corroborated on two planets independently. Planet:168: STATIONED MILITARY LIST — CONFIRMED: std::vector begin, one 16-byte element per military unit. Counts read 3/2/0 for p1/p2/p3 exactly matching the UI, and this was the ONLY (begin,end) pair in the whole object giving that triple. Element: +0 = UPKEEP (3 on all units; NOT rank as once labelled), +4 low16 = unidentified per-unit value, +6/+14 = uninitialised padding holding stale heap bytes, +8 = owner-node, +12 low16 = turnAdded. Experience, rank and next-rank-turns are NOT STORED — all three are derived from turnAdded: experience = 0.2 * (currentTurn - turnAdded), rank = floor(experience / 2), turns-to-next-rank = (2*(rank+1) - experience) / 0.2. Verified on three units with nine exact matches. A planet with no military has all three pointers null, and non-empty lists only ever occur on owned planets

Planet:204: BUILT FACILITIES — an MSVC std::map/set head node keyed by facility type id. Head holds [_Left = leftmost, _Parent = root, _Right = rightmost]; an empty map points all three at itself (p3). Each node is [_Left, _Parent, _Right] then an EMBEDDED Facility at node+12: node+12 = Facility vftable 0x00752BA4, node+16 = facility TYPE ID, node+20 = COUNT of that facility on the planet. Walking it reproduced the UI exactly: p1 farm/shipyard/university/military camp/light turret one each, p2 farm x3, p3 empty, AI shipyard/military camp/light turret. Facility type ids share the Planet:284 id space: 0=farm, 2=shipyard, 4=university, 6=military camp, 9=light turret

Also read 4/1/0 at an earlier facility loadout, 3 on the AI homeworld, and 0 on all 521 uncolonised planets. Increments when a facility of a NEW type completes. It is the SIZE of the Planet:204 facility map — verified equal to the walked node count on all 525 planets. Mirrored at PlanetProperties+120, which is a copy of the Planet field block shifted by exactly 88 bytes (Planet:92->+4, :100->+12, :104->+16, :112->+24, :116->+28, :120->+32, :208->+120)
